arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game battle VFX bank: exactly12 chronological hand-drawn transparent RGBA frames, strict4 columns x3 rows. Equal cells, fixed view/origin. Leave a FULL15% transparent moat on all sides INSIDE EACH CELL so no particle crosses gutters or sheet border. Distinct evolving shapes, not repeated icons or one shape resized. High end SSS limited action RPG: razor-sharp negative-space cuts, layered pearl-silver cutting edge, deep ink INDIGO and AMETHYST secondary ribbons, tiny champagne gold steel sparks, crisp refined cinematic rendering. Pure HUMAN sword technique: no holy imagery, halo, crosses, magic runes, summoned swords, angel wings, character, text, labels, numbers, floor tile, UI, grid, checkerboard. No full white screen or opaque smoke. Transparent negative space between cuts, natural tapered ends. SINGLE SWEEPING SWORD CUT: an elegant but brutal left-to-right crescent. 1-2 a hairline diagonal incision,3-4 the leading silver edge sweeps out and pulls thin violet metallic ribbons behind it,5-6 peak broad crescent with nested trailing fine cuts and silver sparks, center stays open,7-9 crescent breaks into sharp tapered strips and sparks,10-12 fragments taper into nothing. Maximum crescent remains well inside cell, no straight clipped edges, no rectangular effect. Keep enough dark transparent gaps that enemy bodies remain readable. ABSOLUTELY no opaque or cloudy background, no gray backdrop, no grid line. Background and all unused areas are transparent alpha ZERO, not painted black or gray.
